CREATE DOMAIN availability AS period_multirange;
CREATE TYPE booking AS (room integer, slot period);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reservations (
    id integer,
    during floatrange,
    gaps floatmultirange,
    CONSTRAINT reservations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT reservations_during_excl EXCLUDE USING gist (during WITH &&)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION new_diff(
    x integer,
    y integer
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT (x - y)::double precision
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ts_diff(
    x timestamp,
    y timestamp
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x - y))
$$;
CREATE DOMAIN break_set AS stamp_span_multirange;
CREATE TYPE shift_slot AS (room integer, during stamp_span);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stamps (
    id integer,
    during stamp_span,
    breaks stamp_span_multirange,
    history stamp_span[],
    past_breaks stamp_span_multirange[],
    CONSTRAINT stamps_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stamp_length(
    r stamp_span
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (upper(r) - lower(r)))
$$;
GRANT USAGE ON TYPE floatrange TO app_role;
